skills.title: Read File and Generate Chart
steps: Switch to category 'files' and call read_file on the requested file path
Extract labels and numeric values as JSON arrays
Switch to category 'charts' and call generate_chart with the requested chart_type ('bar', 'line', or 'pie'), title, labels_json, and values_json
skills.fix_notes: Never write a Python matplotlib script; always use generate_chart so the PNG saves to Backend/Core/Temporary.

skills.title: Create and Verify Local File
steps: Switch to category 'files' and call create_and_write_file with filename and content
Call read_file on the same filename to confirm the saved content
skills.fix_notes: Always include full path and file extension (e.g., E:\notes.txt).

skills.title: Execute Local Script or Open Generated File
steps: Call run_script passing the exact path in the 'filename' parameter

skills.title: Search Web and Save Summary Note
steps: Switch to category 'basic' and call search_google with the topic query
Switch to category 'files' and call create_and_write_file to save the structured summary to the target file
skills.fix_notes: Ask or confirm target filename if not provided.

skills.title: Open Coding Workspace
skills.fix_notes: Use open_application separately for each app.

skills.title: Launch Roblox with Anti-AFK
skills.fix_notes: Keep Roblox window focused after launch.
